home.heading: Clan Genealogy
home.subheading: Preserving our roots, connecting descendants near and far
home.welcomeBody: The portal is under construction. The interactive family tree, kinship lookup, and anniversary reminders are coming soon.

tree.title: Family tree
tree.desc: Browse the multi-generation tree, collapse or expand each branch.

kinship.title: Kinship lookup
kinship.desc: Find the correct traditional form of address between two members.

events.title: Anniversaries & events
events.desc: Never miss an ancestor's death anniversary, wherever you live.

notifications.title: Notification center
notifications.accountNotLinked: Your account is not linked to anyone in the genealogy yet.
notifications.accountNotLinkedHint: That is why this inbox is empty. Please ask the clan council (Hội đồng Tộc biểu) or your branch head to link your account to your record; you will then receive your chi/nhánh's giỗ reminders.
notifications.pageSubtitle: Every death-anniversary reminder arrives here first.

tree.loadError: Could not load the family tree
tree.rootNotFound: The root person of this tree was not found
tree.fitWholeTreeHint: Zoom out to see the whole loaded phả đồ at once. Text becomes small; pinch or zoom in to read details again.
tree.truncatedBanner: This view is incomplete: {count} branch(es) still have people that have not been loaded. Expand a branch to see more.

legend.title: Legend
legend.adoptedOrEnded: Adoption, or a relationship that has ended

tree.authRequired: Please log in to view the family tree
tree.authRequiredHint: Under Decree 13/2023, visitors who are not logged in cannot see person records. Please log in with your clan account.

person.lunarDayMonth: Day {day}, month {month} of the lunar calendar
person.gioNote: The giỗ (death anniversary) follows the lunar date above.
person.lookupKinship: Look up kinship with this person
person.loadError: Could not load this profile. Please try again.
person.pickerPlaceholder: Type a name to search (accents optional)

kinship.title: Kinship lookup
kinship.subtitle: Pick two people in the clan to see how they should properly address each other.
kinship.hint: Titles come from the clan's own rule set and are always given in Vietnamese. If one looks wrong, tell the clan council so the rule can be corrected.
kinship.emptyPrompt: Choose both people to see the kinship title.
kinship.pathSummary: Up {up} generation(s) to the common ancestor {lca}, then down {down}.
kinship.notFound: One of the two people was not found.
kinship.loadError: Could not resolve the kinship title. Please try again.

SELF.title: Both fields hold the same person

NO_COMMON_ANCESTOR.title: No common ancestor found
NO_COMMON_ANCESTOR.body: In the records we hold, these two are not yet linked through a shared ancestor. The connection may run through the maternal line or a marriage that has not been recorded.

NO_MATCHING_RULE.title: The rule set does not cover this case yet
NO_MATCHING_RULE.body: The relationship was resolved, but no form of address has been defined for it. The facts below are exactly what the clan council needs in order to add the missing rule.

personForm.savedCreate: The person has been added to the genealogy.
personForm.savedWithOverride: Saved, with a note recording the taboo-name collision.
personForm.statusHint: Switch off for someone who has passed away. Entering a date of death also marks them as deceased — you will be asked to confirm.
personForm.privacyLevelHint: Living people are hidden by default. Widen this only with the person's own consent.
personForm.contactHint: Contact details are the most sensitive tier and are visible only to the person themselves and to administrators.
personForm.noteHint: This is written to the edit history so future generations can trace the change.

names.hanNomHint: Fill in if the old clan book records it.

date.precisionHint: Pick what is actually known — do not guess a day.
date.lunarHint: Enter exactly what the clan book records. Nothing is converted here; lunar–solar conversion is done on the server.
date.lunarDeathHint: This lunar date is what the giỗ is calculated from, so enter it carefully. If it fell in a leap month, tick the box above.

relation.enable: Link this person to someone already in the genealogy
relation.hint: Without a link the system cannot work out the generation, and the person will not appear on the tree.
relation.otherIsParent: The selected person is the new record's parent
relation.otherIsChild: The selected person is the new record's child

taboo.title: Taboo-name warning (kỵ húy)
taboo.lead: The name entered collides with the taboo name of {count} ancestor(s).
taboo.explain: By clan custom, naming someone after an ancestor's taboo name is forbidden. Please change the name, or state your reason if you intend to keep it.
taboo.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. approved by the clan council at the meeting on…
taboo.reasonHint: The reason is written to the edit history alongside the override.

deathConfirm.title: You are recording a death
deathConfirm.lead: You are about to record {name} as deceased.
deathConfirm.question: Are you sure? Please read this through before saving.
deathConfirm.dateHint: Please read this date again. One mistyped digit sends the whole chi/nhánh the wrong news.
deathConfirm.consequencePublic: Make {name}'s record public — by genealogy custom a deceased person's record is open to everyone, including guests who are not signed in.
deathConfirm.consequenceGio: Schedule giỗ (death anniversary) reminders from the lunar date of death and send them to the person's chi/nhánh.
deathConfirm.consequenceIrreversible: A mistake can be corrected afterwards, but anything already made public cannot be taken back.

dev.roleTooltip: Only available when running against mock data. Switch roles to see how privacy tiering behaves.

search.title: Search people
search.subtitle: Type a name with or without diacritics; results appear as you type.
search.unaccentedHint: Diacritics are optional. Every name layer is searched: húy, tự, hiệu, thụy, everyday and Buddhist names.
search.idlePrompt: Type a name to start searching.

events.title: Anniversaries & clan events
events.subtitle: Giỗ dates are kept in the lunar calendar; the solar date beside each one is converted by the server.
events.empty: No anniversaries fall in this period.
events.loadError: Could not load the anniversary list. Please try again.
events.branchFilterHint: Clan-wide rites always appear, whichever branch you filter by.
events.unscheduledCount: {n} event(s) have no matching solar date yet.

push.inAppAlways: Either way, every giỗ reminder is waiting in full in your notification centre when you open the app.

prompt.title: Get anniversary reminders on this device?
prompt.body: Turn on push notifications to be reminded 7, 3 and 1 days ahead, even when the app is closed.
prompt.iosBody: On iPhone you must add the app to your Home Screen before push notifications can be enabled.

settings.title: Push notifications on this device
settings.body: Reminders appear on the device itself, even with the app closed. This switch covers only the device and browser you are using now.
settings.inAppBody: Always on and cannot be turned off. This is the primary reminder channel: open the app and everything is there.

status.DENIED: Your browser has blocked notification permission. Re-enable it in browser settings — the app cannot ask again.
status.UNSUPPORTED: This browser does not support push notifications.
status.NO_SERVICE_WORKER: This build has no service worker registered, so push cannot be enabled.

error.PERMISSION_DENIED: You declined notification permission. Every reminder still waits in the notification centre.
error.NO_SERVICE_WORKER: Could not enable push: no service worker.
error.SERVER_NOT_CONFIGURED: The server has no push key configured yet, so this cannot be switched on. Please tell an administrator; every giỗ reminder still waits in the notification centre.
error.SUBSCRIBE_FAILED: Could not register for push notifications. Please try again later.

ios.title: Add to Home Screen (iPhone / iPad)
ios.why: On iOS, push notifications only work once the app has been added to the Home Screen.

steps.share: Open the site in Safari and tap the Share button.
steps.reopen: Reopen the app from its Home Screen icon, then turn reminders on.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Choose how you would like to receive clan reminders and notifications.
